title: Libra increases as the economy eliminates some growth amid the bank's precaution in interest rate cuts
text:
By John-Paul Ford Rojas
Updated: 22:01 GMT, February 13, 2025
The pound increased yesterday when official figures showed that the economy eliminated growth at the end of last year and a top official of the England Bank ruled out cuts of ‘aggressive’ interest rates.
Sterling rose half a penny to spend $ 1.25 against the US dollar after the Office of Data and Comments of the National Statistics Office (ONS) of the Chief Economist of the Huw Pill Bank.
The markets backed the hopes of three interest rates cuts this year, since ONS data delivered a slight postponement to the recent gloom surrounding the economy of the United Kingdom.
The gross domestic product grew by a slow 0.1 percent in the fourth quarter of last year.
But that was better than the contraction of 0.1 percent predicted by many economists.
And Pill said that with inflation on a road down, although it is expected to increase briefly later this year, the bank had been able to start reducing the rates.
Pound Up: Sterling rose to more than $ 1.25 against the US dollar after GDP grew by a slow 0.1% in the fourth quarter of last year
But he warned that the process of ‘deflation’ was not yet complete.
“That means that we cannot simply eliminate all the restriction overnight, reduce aggressively rates, etc.,” he said, he added: “I would expect that we will further reduce the bank rate. But the rhythm you can Doing it is less.
Last week, the rate was reduced from 4.75 percent to 4.5 percent.
The caution of the pill underlines the division in the heart of the monetary policy committee of nine members of the bank.
Catherine Mann was one of the two to vote for a half -percentage point cut Jumbo, suggesting that a worsening perspective required a more drastic action.
